source_name: Hranilnica LON d.d. Kranj – Zaposlitev
why_relevant: Smallest tier of SI deposit-takers. Page was reported as carrying no current openings and inviting speculative applications by post/email (kadri@lon.si) — a legitimate zero-signal baseline. Any future posting here is disproportionately informative given how rarely LON hires publicly.

source_name: NLB Lease&Go – Zaposlitev (NLB group non-bank subsidiary)
why_relevant: Group subsidiaries hire separately from the parent and are often omitted from the group careers portal. Leasing/consumer-finance hiring is an early indicator of NLB group product expansion and of shared-service reorganisation.

source_name: Optius.com employer profiles for Slovenian banks
why_relevant: Slovenian job aggregator with per-employer profile pages for essentially every bank in scope (NLB d.d., Banka Koper, Dezelna banka, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Banka Sparkasse, UniCredit Banka Slovenije, BKS Bank AG, Bankart d.o.o.). Its 'Bancnistvo, Finance' sector view is a single pane that surfaces bank vacancies which never appear on, or are removed early from, the banks' own pages — and it is the fastest way to enumerate additional bank actors for this cell.

source_name: Careerjet.si – per-company bank vacancy views
why_relevant: Meta-aggregator that indexes bank vacancies from many SI portals and from the banks' own ATSes, with per-company views (NLB, NLB Group, Intesa Sanpaolo, Gorenjska Banka, Delavska hranilnica). Useful as a redundancy/backfill layer to detect postings that vanished from a primary source between polls, and to catch banks not yet on the actor list.

source_name: BetterCareer.si – IT-role views for Slovenian banks
why_relevant: Slovenian IT-specialised job portal with dedicated company pages for Banka Intesa Sanpaolo, SKB Banka, Delavska hranilnica and Bankart. Because it is IT-only, it acts as a pre-filtered feed for exactly the technology roles this cell cares about (core banking, payments, digital channels), removing branch-advisor noise.

source_name: University career-office and alumni vacancy relays (FMF UL, Karierni center EF, Alumni EF, Karierni sejem)
why_relevant: Slovenian banks and Bankart route graduate/junior technical vacancies through university career offices (Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, Faculty of Economics) and career fairs. These relays capture entry-level and internship hiring — the earliest signal of a team being stood up — that is often absent from corporate career pages, and frequently name the concrete team and technology.

source_name: Nexi Group — global job openings portal (Slovenia filter)
why_relevant: Nexi runs card processing and development offices in Ljubljana and Koper (ex-Plačilni sistemi / Mercury lineage). Group ATS postings filtered to Slovenia expose local headcount and function mix without bank-only searches seeing them.

source_name: Mercury Processing Services International — Careers
why_relevant: Mercury (est. 2009, HR+SI footprint, now within the Nexi orbit) processes payments for CEE/MENA financial institutions; its openings show which processing capabilities are being staffed in Slovenia.

source_name: mBills — Zaposlitev
why_relevant: mBills is one of the small set of licensed Slovenian e-money institutions (mobile wallet, Petrol group lineage). Direct careers page for an EMI that is not a bank.

source_name: Banka Slovenije — Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev in infrastruktur
why_relevant: Oversight section for non-bank PSPs and FMIs; publications here (incl. Poročilo o delovanju plačilnega sistema) frame scheme migrations that drive hiring waves at processors.

source_name: AJPES ePRS — Poslovni register Slovenije (person search)
why_relevant: Statutory business register: searching by person reveals whether an individual is a founder, shareholder, representative (zastopnik) or supervisory-body member of any Slovenian entity. This is the ground truth for leadership changes at payment institutions, and it lands before press coverage.

source_name: Optius.com — company job pages for payments employers
why_relevant: Slovenian job aggregator with per-company landing pages; captures postings that never reach the employer's own site and normalizes them by field (informatika/programiranje) and location. Notably lists both Halcom d.d. and the separate legal entity Halcom plačila d.o.o. — an org-structure signal in itself.

source_name: BetterCareer.si — IT company job pages
why_relevant: IT-focused Slovenian job board with per-company views for Bankart and Halcom; useful cross-check on technical role mix (payments engineering, ISO 20022, core processing).

source_name: Joberty — Slovenian tech employer profiles and job ads
why_relevant: Adriatic-region developer platform carrying job ads plus employee reviews and salary signals for fintech employers such as Bitstamp; useful for role-level detail bank-only sources miss.

source_name: CryptoJobsList — Ljubljana / Bitstamp listings
why_relevant: Vertical board covering the crypto-payments corner of the cell (Bitstamp, GoCrypto/Eligma). Zero-openings states are themselves a signal — Bitstamp showed no open roles in mid-2026 post-Robinhood acquisition.

source_name: Workable job search — Bitstamp Slovenia
why_relevant: ATS-level view of a Ljubljana-rooted payments/crypto employer; ATS boards are more complete and better structured than curated aggregators, and often expose a JSON API.

source_name: startup.si — Slovenian startup/scaleup map (Paywiser entry)
why_relevant: State-backed startup map that enumerates Slovenian fintech/payments companies with founder and contact data — a snowball source for actors below the licensing radar that bank-focused searches never surface.

source_name: European Payments Council — Slovenia instant payment environment insight
why_relevant: Documents that BIPS was implemented by Bankart in 2019 on the SCT Inst scheme — the scheme-migration context that explains and dates payments hiring waves. Useful as a benchmark layer, not as a hiring feed.

source_name: KiTalent — FinTech executive search (Slovenian-language practice page)
why_relevant: Executive-search firm marketing to Slovenian fintech; search-firm content and mandates reveal which leadership seats are being filled before any appointment is announced. Classic 'who sells into the change' source.

source_name: ZRSZ (Zavod RS za zaposlovanje) — public employment service job listings
why_relevant: State employment service; its EURES page also enumerates the Slovenian private job-portal landscape (MojeDelo, Kariera, Competo, Deloglasnik, Zaposlitev.info, Rekruter…), which is the pointer value. Some vacancies are legally required to be reported here.

source_name: Glassdoor — Mercury Processing Services International employer profile
why_relevant: Employee-review surface for a processor with SI headcount; reorganizations, layoffs and management churn frequently show up in reviews before any public announcement.

source_name: AJPES Uradne objave - eObjave vpisov v sodni register (court register entry publications)
why_relevant: This is the highest-value single feed for the cell: AJPES publishes every court-register entry decision, including entries of changes of management board members (clani uprave), supervisory board members (clani nadzornega sveta) and representatives, with the decision date. It converts a leadership rumour into a dated, legally confirmed fact, and surfaces changes that were never announced in a press release.

source_name: Sodni register RS (Slovenian court register) - AJPES access point
why_relevant: The court register is the constitutive register for d.d. / d.o.o. entities: management and supervisory board composition and representation powers take legal effect on entry here. It is the authoritative cross-check on any claimed leadership move at a Slovenian bank or payment institution, and its document collection (zbirka listin) reveals shareholder resolutions on appointments and dismissals.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register of payment institutions (EN)
why_relevant: Authoritative list of payment institutions licensed or registered by Banka Slovenije, published with their representatives and branches. New authorisations are the strongest leading indicator of new payments employers about to hire in SI; the representative field doubles as a leadership-change signal.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Plačilne institucije držav EGP v Sloveniji (EEA passported payment institutions)
why_relevant: Lists EEA payment institutions passporting into Slovenia, including which operate through a branch or agent in SI. Branch/agent establishment is a concrete organisation-change and local-hiring signal for foreign payments players that would otherwise be invisible in SI-domiciled registers.

source_name: EBA EUCLID - Payment Institutions Register (PIR), filterable to Slovenia
why_relevant: Pan-EEA register of payment institutions, e-money institutions, AISPs, their agents and branches, plus excluded and formerly authorised entities, searchable by country and competent authority. Filtering to SI gives a machine-readable, comparably structured mirror of the Banka Slovenije registers and additionally exposes agents - a population invisible in most national views.

source_name: EBA EUCLID - Credit Institutions Register (CIR), filterable to Slovenia
why_relevant: Authoritative EU-level list of authorised credit institutions per member state, built from competent-authority submissions. Filtering to SI yields the definitive bank population with LEIs and authorisation dates - the identifier backbone for joining register data to job postings, news and leadership records.
